name: demo-aquila-cockpit
description: Cockpit web bundle. Declares module format and the test command; it is NOT a dependency manifest — see the note below.
//: There is no npm install, no bundler and no node_modules: the bundle is
plain ES modules copied verbatim into an nginx image that also builds for
arm64, and the npm supply chain is exactly what should not travel to the
module. This file exists so that node treats .js as ESM when running the
tests, and so `npm test` has a meaning. Adding a dependency here means
reopening that decision, not just editing a line.
